title: 🥭MPR
tagline: Mango Farmers Club: The first community token project on Polygon zkEVM
description: The Mango Farmers Club (MFC) is a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) dedicated to promoting the adoption of Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) infrastructure on the Polygon zkEVM ecosystem. To distribute its tokens, MFC will conduct an airdrop and hold a public registration event, with no allocation reserved for the team. The funds raised from the registration event will be sent to the Mango Treasury, which will distribute 0.1% of its USDC balance as daily dividends to MANGO farmers(stakers).
how_its_made:
In general, building a project like the Mango Farmers Club DAO would require a variety of technologies, including blockchain technology, smart contracts, and decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols. These technologies are typically pieced together to create a functioning ecosystem that can be used by stakeholders.

For example, the Mango Farmers Club DAO would need to use a blockchain network like Polygon zkEVM to provide a secure and decentralized infrastructure for its operations. The DAO would also need to create smart contracts to automate its processes, such as the distribution of daily dividends to stakers. Additionally, the project would need to integrate with DeFi protocols like CLOB infrastructure to enable trading and liquidity on the platform.
